title: JSUI
idiom: hand-coloured 19th-century paper toy-theatre print, a blank canvas stage wired into a patch
hero_prompt: Hand-coloured 19th-century paper toy-theatre print, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible printed line and watercolour texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a small proscenium toy theatre with red painted curtains drawn back to reveal a stage that is a blank glowing canvas, on which a little cat and a crescent moon are being sketched in lines of light; from the wings of the theatre a tangle of coloured patch cables runs out across the table. Red, gold, deep green and cream.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a gold ground, no shading or gradients: a small toy-theatre proscenium arch with its curtains drawn open and a small cat shape standing on the empty stage. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
